title: 第1章 坑爹的系统
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
又是一声兽吼，林锋缩了下脖子，掸落掉在身上的树叶，看着黑暗中的群山，心里暗叹，这里和地球可真是完全不一样。
林锋坐在树下发呆，对面几个身形剽悍的少年都用鄙夷的目光打量他，一个小胖子更是冲着林锋喊道：“留你一个外乡人在村里可不是让你吃干饭的，赶紧干活去！”
林锋回过神来，没有说话，拍拍屁股站起来走开。
他的身后，小胖子哼了一声：“没用的废物，体力连个小孩子都不如，就该把他扔到山里让凶兽吃掉！”
林锋撇撇嘴，哥一个穿越来的地球人，怎么跟你们这群牲口比体力？
这个天元大世界，是一个修真者主宰的世界。
眼前这个狼村，不过是莽莽大山里的一个小村落，修真者自然是没有的，但每一个村民都苦练武技，打熬力气，连妇女儿童也不例外。
只有这样，才能在这个凶兽横行，甚至有太古遗种出没的世界中生存。
就像现在，虽然是深夜了，村中的青壮也要进山狩猎，很多猎物都习惯夜间出来活动，夜晚进山虽然危险重重，但收获也会更大。
村里人都已经习惯这种生活，留在村里的孩子们也不睡觉，就聚在一起较技玩耍，等待自家大人狩猎归来。
还拖着清鼻涕的小孩子，混不在意的拿几十上百斤的石锁当玩具耍弄，一群十几岁大的少年则在比试谁能举起村口重达千斤的巨鼎。
林锋看着这群小牲口，暗叹了口气，跟他们比力气，自己确实显得很废柴。
但这不会让林锋感到沮丧，虽然不时被人在身后议论，但他还是凭借忽悠本事在这个名为狼村的小山村中暂住下来。真正让他蛋疼的是，他的脑海里多了一样东西。
超级祖师系统。
刚开始林锋还心里直乐，想着穿越就是有福利，但系统说明第一条就让他心凉了半截。
“系统主线任务：宿主开山立派，建立此方世界第一大宗门，成为第一祖师。”
“主线任务分不同阶段，每阶段需在限定时间内完成，超时未完成，直接抹杀宿主！”
林锋看着系统说明，尤其是最后一句“抹杀宿主”，半天无语，最后从牙缝中挤出几个字：“我去年买了个表！”
愤怒过后，林锋无奈的这个世界屁股都还没坐热，他不想再死一回。
主线任务1.0——收纳四名亲传衣钵弟子。

任务说明：哪怕是个散修，想要传承自己的衣钵，也要收徒。一个门派最重要的资源，永远是人，是天赋出众的弟子传人，名师出高徒，名师难求，高徒更难求。
任务时限：一年，超时未完成，直接抹杀宿主。
“坑爹啊！”林锋叹了口气，就咱这刚穿越过来的新人，稚嫩的就像一棵爽口小白菜，我才应该赶紧找个大牛当师傅，好好抱一抱大腿吧？
系统大哥你好歹给我本秘籍，才好去收徒弟，这一穷二白的，你让我教人家什么？忽悠和吹逼吗？
更坑的是，系统说明有新手礼包，却告知自己礼包系统发生故障，新手礼包延时发放，让林锋感叹没有最坑爹只有更坑爹。
开启的兑换系统，倒是各种好东西玲琅满目，灵丹法宝，功法神通，只有你想不到，没有他没货。
问题是，所有东西都需要兑换点数来换，而林锋眼下哪怕一个兑换点数都没有，只能冲着系统翻白眼。
林锋正在心里骂娘，村口突然起了骚动，看样子是狩猎队伍回来了。
村中等待的少年们都欢呼着向村口迎去，林锋无所谓的瞥了一眼，却愕然发现，狩猎归来的一众青壮，竟然全部空手而归，没有猎物不说，连武器都不见了。
对于这些村民来说，武器就是第二生命，生活在这大山中，没有武器根本活不下去。
林锋嘴角勾起一个不易察觉的笑容：“似乎有故事啊。”想到这里，他也向村口人群走去。
还没靠近，就听见有人怒吼道：“狼风是我们狼村的希望，现在被石村的人打成重伤，绝不能善罢甘休！”
林锋抬眼望去，就见人群中间一个少年神情萎顿的跌坐在地上，满身伤痕，眼睛中冒出仇恨冰冷的光芒。

content_en:
There was another beast roar, Lin Feng shrank his neck, dusted off the fallen leaves, looked at the mountains in the darkness, and sighed in his heart, this place is really completely different from the earth.
Lin Feng sat in a daze under the tree. Several tough young men across from him looked at him with disdain. A little fat man even shouted at Lin Feng: "You are not a stranger left in the village to make a living for you, go to work quickly!"
Lin Feng came to his senses, said nothing, patted his butt, stood up and walked away.
Behind him, the little fat man snorted: "You're a useless piece of trash. His physical strength is not as good as that of a child. You should throw him into the mountains and let the beasts eat him!"
Lin Feng curled his lips, how could a time-travelling earthling compete with you guys in terms of physical strength?
This great world of Tianyuan is a world dominated by cultivators.
The Wolf Village in front of us is just a small village in the vast mountains. There are naturally no cultivators, but every villager has worked hard to practice martial arts and work hard, including women and children.
Only in this way can we survive in this world where ferocious beasts are rampant and even ancient relics appear.
Just like now, even though it is late at night, the young men in the village still go into the mountains to hunt. Many prey are accustomed to coming out at night. Although going into the mountains at night is full of dangers, the rewards will be greater.
People in the village have become accustomed to this kind of life. The children who stay in the village don't sleep. They gather together to compete and play, waiting for their adults to return from hunting.
The children, who were still dragging their noses to clear their noses, were carelessly playing with stone locks weighing dozens or hundreds of kilograms as toys, while a group of teenagers were competing to see who could lift a gigantic cauldron weighing a thousand kilograms at the entrance of the village.
Lin Feng looked at these little animals and sighed secretly. Compared with them, he really looked like a loser.
But this did not make Lin Feng feel depressed. Although he was talked about behind his back from time to time, he still relied on his deception skills to temporarily stay in this small mountain village called Langcun. What really made his balls ache was that there was something else in his mind.
Super ancestor system.
Lin Feng was very happy at first, thinking that time travel would bring benefits, but the first explanation from the system made him feel cold.
"The main mission of the system: the host establishes a sect, establishes the largest sect in the world, and becomes the first ancestor."
"The main mission is divided into different stages. Each stage must be completed within a limited time. If it is not completed within the time limit, the host will be directly obliterated!"
Lin Feng looked at the system instructions, especially the last sentence "Erase the host". He was speechless for a long time, and finally squeezed out a few words through his teeth: "I bought a watch last year!"
After the anger, Lin Feng felt helpless that the world was still hot, and he didn't want to die again.
Main mission 1.0 - Acquire four direct disciples of the mantle.
Mission statement: Even if you are a casual cultivator, if you want to pass on your legacy, you must recruit disciples. The most important resource of a sect is always its people, the successors of talented disciples. Famous teachers give birth to great disciples. Famous teachers are hard to find, and great disciples are even harder to find.
Mission time limit: one year. If it is not completed within the time limit, the host will be directly wiped out.
"You're cheating!" Lin Feng sighed. We are a newcomer who has just traveled through time. He is as immature as a refreshing cabbage. I should quickly find a master to be my master and give him a hug, right?
Brother System, please give me this secret book so that I can recruit a disciple. This poor guy, what do you want me to teach you? Flirting and bragging?
What's even more embarrassing is that the system stated that there was a novice gift pack, but informed him that the gift pack system was malfunctioning and the novice gift pack was delayed, making Lin Feng lament that there was no more cheating, only more cheating.
The exchange system that has been opened has a dazzling array of good things, elixirs, magic weapons, and magical powers that you can't even imagine.
The problem is that everything requires exchange points, and Lin Feng doesn't have even one exchange point at the moment, so he can only roll his eyes at the system.
Lin Feng was cursing his mother in his mind when suddenly there was a commotion at the entrance of the village.Move, it looks like the hunting team is back.
The waiting teenagers in the village cheered and headed towards the entrance of the village. Lin Feng glanced at them indifferently, but was shocked to find that all the young men returning from hunting came back empty-handed. There was no prey, and even their weapons were missing.
For these villagers, weapons are their second life. Living in this mountain, it is impossible to survive without weapons.
An imperceptible smile appeared on Lin Feng's lips: "There seems to be a story." Thinking of this, he also walked towards the crowd at the entrance of the village.
Before he even got close, he heard someone roar: "Lang Feng is the hope of our Wolf Village. Now that he has been seriously injured by the people of Stone Village, we must not let it go!"
Lin Feng looked up and saw a young man sitting on the ground with a depressed expression in the middle of the crowd. His body was covered with scars, and his eyes were filled with cold light of hatred.
